title: SKE Crystal Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blueberry Sour Raspberry flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salt e-liquid provides a vibrant contrast of sweet Blueberries and fresh, slightly sour Raspberries. This e-liquid balances the natural sweetness of blueberries with the invigorating tartness of sour raspberries, offering a layered and engaging taste that's both refreshing and satisfying. Utilizing the advantages of nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers a smoother throat hit at higher nicotine strengths, making it ideal for vapers looking to transition from smoking to vaping. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a great balance between flavour fidelity and cloud production, making it suitable for a range of mouth-to-lung devices such as pod systems. SKE Crystal Nic Salts are known for their exceptional flavour profiles and this flavour is a testament to their quality. Whether you're a fan of fruity vapes or new to nicotine salts, Blueberry Sour Raspberry is a must-try within this diverse collection. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
